summary: Phase 12 Procurement Pillar (BoQ/RAB, Subcontractor+SPK, PO/GRN/3-way match) - Comprehensive end-to-end testing completed. All backend APIs working correctly with anti-fraud controls verified. Frontend pages accessible with proper navigation and data display.
passed_tests: AUTH: All staff logins working (owner, pm, finance, site, sales) - 5/5 passed
BoQ APIs: GET items (6 items, Rp 472M budget), GET summary (budget vs committed vs actual), POST create, DELETE item - 4/4 passed
Subcontractor APIs: GET list (2 subcons), POST create, GET detail with SPK - 3/3 passed
SPK APIs: GET list (2 SPK, Rp 450M contract value), POST create (SPK/2026/0003), POST status update to active - 3/3 passed
Procurement PO APIs: GET list (2 POs), POST create regular PO (Rp 50M), POST create high-value PO (Rp 600M, high_value=true) - 3/3 passed
ANTI-FRAUD Segregation of Duties: PM cannot approve own PO (403 ✓), Finance CAN approve regular PO (200 ✓) - 2/2 passed
ANTI-FRAUD Tiered Approval: Finance cannot approve high-value PO >Rp 500M (403 ✓), Owner CAN approve (200 ✓) - 2/2 passed
GRN APIs: GET list (1 GRN), POST create GRN (50 qty, Rp 25M), PO status updated to partially_received - 2/2 passed

3-Way Match: GET threeway list (2 matched, 1 flagged), POST bill matched scenario (claimed <= received, status=matched ✓), POST bill flagged scenario (claimed > received, status=flagged ✓, reasons listed) - 3/3 passed
Material Stock Sync: GRN creates material_txn (6 GRN-related txns found ✓) - 1/1 passed
RBAC: Sales denied access to BoQ (403 ✓) and Procurement (403 ✓) - 2/2 passed
FRONTEND Login: Quick-login buttons working (Owner, Manajer, Sales, Finance, Proyek) - 1/1 passed

FRONTEND BoQ Page: Accessible via nav, metrics displayed (Anggaran Rp 472M, Komitmen Rp 825M, Realisasi Rp 377.5M, Sisa -Rp 353M), over-budget warning shown, 6 items table, Tambah Item button - 1/1 passed

FRONTEND Subcon Page: Accessible via nav, tabs (Subkontraktor + SPK) working, 3 subcontractors listed, 3 SPK listed with metrics (Total SPK: 3, Aktif: 2, Nilai Kontrak: Rp 550M), Buat SPK button - 1/1 passed

FRONTEND Procurement Page: Accessible via nav, tabs (Purchase Order + 3-Way Match) working, 4 PO rows displayed, 3-Way Match tab shows Cocok (Matched): 2, Ditandai (Flagged): 2, Buat PO button - 1/1 passed
REGRESSION: Homepage, Finance, Construction, Materials, Field Ops pages all load without red-screen errors - 5/5 passed
